extra rule (stateful, stage identity): Decline handling: explain the purpose of the questions once. Close as declined on a second refusal or a second 'what is this about' question. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (computational, stage negotiate): Accept amounts proposed by the customer from the floor up to the full past-due amount, both included. Reject amounts below the floor. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
